# Dipen Modi

> Senior Frontend Developer in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. I turn designs into responsive, maintainable interfaces. 6+ years of experience building custom WordPress and Craft CMS sites, API-driven dashboards and interactive client tools.

Senior Frontend Developer with 6+ years of professional web development experience and earlier part-time design experience. Contributed to approximately 90–100 websites and web applications across SaaS, finance, e-commerce, real estate, hospitality and other sectors.

## About

I started in 2018 doing part-time web and graphic design at GlooCab, creating digital assets and supporting website presentation.

In 2020 I joined iFlair Web Technologies as a web designer, converting PSD and Adobe XD designs into responsive layouts and WordPress themes. That work pulled me into frontend development: I became a frontend developer in 2022 and a senior frontend developer in 2023, working with Vue.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS and SCSS.

From March 2024 to October 2026 I was a senior frontend developer at IZYGROW BV, building Craft CMS templates, SaaS dashboard components for Payit, interactive elements like configurators and SVG maps, and Laravel-based application frontends together with backend developers.

I translate Figma designs into responsive interfaces, build custom WordPress and Craft CMS solutions, and develop API-driven dashboards and interactive client tools. I work closely with designers, clients and backend developers to get there.

## Own products

- [ElementLens](https://dipenmodidesigns.github.io/projects/elementlens/): Free browser extension: pick any element on a web page and copy its HTML, CSS, Tailwind or JSX. Live: https://dipenmodidesigns.github.io/ElementLens/
- [OrganizeAgain](https://dipenmodidesigns.github.io/projects/organizeagain/): Invoicing for freelancers and small agencies: clients, projects and invoices in one place. Live: https://organizeagain.app/
